1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites__.

2) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with said multivalent cation crosslinker__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __and wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is used in combination with said polymer__.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites__.

12) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 10, __wherein said nanoparticle entraps a multivalent cation and is used in combination with said polymer__.

13) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __and wherein said composition is used with a polymer having anionic sites__.

21) (Currently amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

26) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
